findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 26 requests to 8 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

4 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: chartbeat.com (Chartbeat, analytics), chartbeat.net (Chartbeat, analytics), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement).
2 cookies were set by third-party domains (18 cookies in total).
